"""
Built on LiveKit for real-time voice conversations
"""

import logging
from enum import StrEnum

import structlog
from ddtrace import patch
from livekit.agents import JobContext


patch(structlog=True)


class LogLevel(StrEnum):
    DEBUG = "DEBUG"
    INFO = "INFO"
    WARNING = "WARNING"
    ERROR = "ERROR"
    CRITICAL = "CRITICAL"
    NOTSET = "NOTSET"


def _get_standard_processors(dev_mode: bool = False):
    """Get the standard set of processors for structlog configuration."""
    return [
        structlog.stdlib.filter_by_level,
        structlog.stdlib.add_logger_name,
        structlog.stdlib.add_log_level,
        structlog.stdlib.PositionalArgumentsFormatter(),
        structlog.processors.TimeStamper(fmt="iso"),
        structlog.processors.StackInfoRenderer(),
        structlog.processors.format_exc_info,
        structlog.processors.UnicodeDecoder(),
        structlog.processors.CallsiteParameterAdder(
            parameters=[
                structlog.processors.CallsiteParameter.FILENAME,
                structlog.processors.CallsiteParameter.LINENO,
            ]
        ),
        structlog.contextvars.merge_contextvars,
        structlog.processors.dict_tracebacks,
        structlog.processors.JSONRenderer(indent=2 if dev_mode else None),
    ]


def configure_logging_from_environment(dev_mode: bool = False):
    """
    Reconfigure logging for a specific environment.

    Args:
        dev_mode: True for development, False for production, None to use environment default
    """
    # Get the standard processors
    processors = _get_standard_processors(dev_mode)

    # Configure structlog with the processors
    structlog.configure(
        processors=processors,
        context_class=dict,
        logger_factory=structlog.stdlib.LoggerFactory(),
        wrapper_class=structlog.stdlib.BoundLogger,
        cache_logger_on_first_use=True,
    )


configure_logging_from_environment()


def set_log_level(level: LogLevel, reconfigure_all_logs: bool = False):
    """Set the logging level for both structlog and standard logging."""
    structlog.configure(wrapper_class=structlog.make_filtering_bound_logger(level))
    logging.root.setLevel(level)

    if reconfigure_all_logs:
        # Also update any existing loggers
        for logger_name in logging.root.manager.loggerDict:
            logger = logging.getLogger(logger_name)
            logger.setLevel(level)
            # Ensure logger doesn't have its own handlers that bypass root
            logger.handlers.clear()
            logger.propagate = True


def configure_logging_from_ctx(ctx: JobContext):
    """Add job context details to structured logging context."""
    structlog.contextvars.clear_contextvars()
    structlog.contextvars.bind_contextvars(
        livekit_job_id=ctx.job.id,
        livekit_room_name=ctx.job.room.name,
        livekit_ctx_metadata=ctx.job.metadata,
        livekit_ctx_room_metadata=ctx.job.room.metadata,
    )


def get_logger(name: str) -> structlog.stdlib.BoundLogger:
    """Get a structured logger instance."""
    logger = structlog.get_logger(name)
    return logger

"""
Built on LiveKit for real-time voice conversations
"""

import logging
from enum import StrEnum

import structlog
from ddtrace import patch
from livekit.agents import JobContext


patch(structlog=True)


class LogLevel(StrEnum):
    DEBUG = "DEBUG"
    INFO = "INFO"
    WARNING = "WARNING"
    ERROR = "ERROR"
    CRITICAL = "CRITICAL"
    NOTSET = "NOTSET"


def _get_standard_processors(dev_mode: bool = False):
    """Get the standard set of processors for structlog configuration."""
    return [
        structlog.stdlib.filter_by_level,
        structlog.stdlib.add_logger_name,
        structlog.stdlib.add_log_level,
        structlog.stdlib.PositionalArgumentsFormatter(),
        structlog.processors.TimeStamper(fmt="iso"),
        structlog.processors.StackInfoRenderer(),
        structlog.processors.format_exc_info,
        structlog.processors.UnicodeDecoder(),
        structlog.processors.CallsiteParameterAdder(
            parameters=[
                structlog.processors.CallsiteParameter.FILENAME,
                structlog.processors.CallsiteParameter.LINENO,
            ]
        ),
        structlog.contextvars.merge_contextvars,
        structlog.processors.dict_tracebacks,
        structlog.processors.JSONRenderer(indent=2 if dev_mode else None),
    ]


def configure_logging_from_environment(dev_mode: bool = False):
    """
    Reconfigure logging for a specific environment.

    Args:
        dev_mode: True for development, False for production, None to use environment default
    """
    # Get the standard processors
    processors = _get_standard_processors(dev_mode)

    # Configure structlog with the processors
    structlog.configure(
        processors=processors,
        context_class=dict,
        logger_factory=structlog.stdlib.LoggerFactory(),
        wrapper_class=structlog.stdlib.BoundLogger,
        cache_logger_on_first_use=True,
    )


configure_logging_from_environment()


def set_log_level(level: LogLevel, reconfigure_all_logs: bool = False):
    """Set the logging level for both structlog and standard logging."""
    structlog.configure(wrapper_class=structlog.make_filtering_bound_logger(level))
    logging.root.setLevel(level)


def configure_logging_from_ctx(ctx: JobContext):
    """Add job context details to structured logging context."""
    structlog.contextvars.clear_contextvars()
    structlog.contextvars.bind_contextvars(
        livekit_job_id=ctx.job.id,
        livekit_room_name=ctx.job.room.name,
        livekit_ctx_metadata=ctx.job.metadata,
        livekit_ctx_room_metadata=ctx.job.room.metadata,
    )


def get_logger(name: str) -> structlog.stdlib.BoundLogger:
    """Get a structured logger instance."""
    logger = structlog.get_logger(name)
    return logger
